# Urgent Electrical

> NICEIC-approved electricians serving Nottingham and the East Midlands. Book fixed-price electrical services online 24/7 — emergency callouts, EICR, PAT testing, fault finding, and more.

Urgent Electrical Services (Company No. 08956007) provides domestic and commercial electrical work across the East Midlands. Customers can browse services, check local coverage, and book online with transparent pricing. Fully insured; established 2014.

Phone: 0115 778 0622
Website: https://www.urgentelectrical.services
Sitemap: https://www.urgentelectrical.services/sitemap.xml

## Bookable services

- [Emergency Response 24/7](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/emergency-response-247): Book an emergency electrician for immediate response
- [Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR)](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/electrical-installation-condition-report-eicr): EICR for landlords, buyers, and sellers
- [Portable Appliance Testing (PAT)](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/portable-appliance-testing-pat): PAT testing for workplaces and rental properties
- [Fire Alarm Inspection & Testing](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/fire-alarm-inspection-testing): Fire alarm inspection and testing
- [Emergency Lighting Periodic Inspection](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/emergency-lighting-periodic-inspection-testing-certificate): Emergency lighting inspection, testing, and certificate
- [Domestic Electrical Fault Investigation](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/domestic-electrical-fault-investigation): Fault finding for tripping breakers, power loss, and wiring issues
- [Fuse Box (Consumer Unit) Replacement](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/fuse-box-consumer-unit-replacement): Fixed-price consumer unit upgrades
- [Bathroom Extractor Fan Replacement](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/bathroom-extractor-fan-replacement): Bathroom extractor fan supply and replacement
- [Electrical Panel Heater](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/electrical-panel-heater): Wall-mounted panel heater replacement
- [Socket Replacement](https://www.urgentelectrical.services/services/socket-replacment): Single or double socket replacement
